title: I Connected Claude to Adobe and It Edits Everything
description:
Claude can now plug directly into Adobe, so you can edit photos and videos, remove backgrounds, retouch portraits, and resize any post for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube just by asking in plain English. Here is how the Adobe for creativity connector works, and how to use around forty of the tools free with no Adobe account.

Get the ADOBE Guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qVbmoGu2IuT16SINtwmhUnChN6b8of_06rXgyd18U6o/edit?usp=sharing
